links.outcome: Accuracy, completeness and appropriateness of LLM dietary advice for urine abnormalities, rated by experts
links.effect: Average scores 5.2/6 accuracy, 2.4/3 completeness, 2.6/3 appropriateness; poor on calcium and citrate abnormalities; failed to address 3/10 abnormalities entirely.
links.quote: The model performed particularly poorly in response to calcium and citrate abnormalities and failed to address 3/10 abnormalities entirely.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4's accuracy and appropriateness in analyzing synthetic 24-hour urine collection results and generating dietary recommendations, assessed offline by expert clinicians.
